status: OFFERED — a registration offered to the Layer O umbrella lane (layer-o-umbrella-20260924); not an edit of its registry, not merged into it, not a board change

registry_read.vocabulary_used: umbrella.authority_states and umbrella.evidence_states exactly as the registry lists them; wedge ids and axis ids exactly as its wedges{} and axes[].axis list them

mapping_rule: A wedge is named only if it exists in the registry's wedges{}. An axis is named under a wedge only when (a) the registry lists it in that wedge's axes, (b) it is on the live board (registry axes[]), and (c) the board axis's own task reads the same kind of fact this harness reads. Otherwise the wedge is named with axes [] and the reason, and near-miss axes go under adjacent_board_axes, which contribute nothing. No harness here contributes to any axis value: each wedge's contract is honoured as application_view_only=true and cannot_override_axis_truth=true, and reverify_only_affected_dependencies=true is carried through as depends_on.
